female-technical-specificity-faster.title: Female borrowers who list specific products or goals beyond family welfare fund faster.
female-technical-specificity-faster.body: Pitches from women that detail specific business inputs, professional skills, or concrete objectives beyond general family security accelerate funding.

business-duration-faster.title: Specifying the number of years a business has operated predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
business-duration-faster.body: Pitches that include the specific duration of business operation or professional experience tend to accelerate funding for both men and women.

female-savings-goal-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention the goal of building savings fund faster.
female-savings-goal-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly state the intention to build up savings are associated with increased funding speed.

female-nwtf-history-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention a history of successful loans from NWTF fund faster.
female-nwtf-history-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly reference previous successful loan cycles with NWTF are associated with increased funding speed.

verbosity-slower-general.title: Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
verbosity-slower-general.body: Pitches that are significantly longer or contain excessive personal narrative tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

female-family-details-slower.title: Pitches from women that include specific family details fund more slowly.
female-family-details-slower.body: Pitches from women that include references to their children or specific family obligations are associated with slower funding speeds.

monthly-income-slower-general.title: Pitches that include specific monthly income figures predict slower funding regardless of gender.
monthly-income-slower-general.body: The inclusion of precise monthly income amounts is associated with slower funding speeds for both male and female borrowers.

female-business-success-faster.title: Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
female-business-success-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight current business success or the ability to sustain operations through previous support accelerate funding.

female-past-failure-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention specific past failures or debts may fund more slowly.

female-traumatic-history-slower.body: Female borrowers who include narrative descriptions of traumatic personal history may fund more slowly.

female-family-future-phrasing-faster.body: Female borrowers using the specific phrase 'secure the future of her family' may fund faster.

male-location-specificity-faster.body: Male borrowers who mention a specific town or region may fund faster.

male-school-fees-slower.body: Male borrowers who mention using profits for school fees may fund more slowly.

male-technical-specificity-faster.body: Male borrowers who provide precise technical quantities (e.g., feed weight) may fund faster.

female-marital-status-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention their marital status in their pitch may fund faster.

female-home-ownership-faster.body: Female borrowers who explicitly mention owning their own house may fund faster.

female-children-education-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention the education of their children may fund faster.

female-character-praise-slower.body: Female borrowers who include general praise of their character or expressions of gratitude may fund more slowly.

female-child-count-slower.title: Female borrowers who specify the exact number of children they have may fund more slowly.

female-child-photo-id-slower.title: Female borrowers who include notes identifying the children in their photos may fund more slowly.

female-family-future-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention securing the future of their children or family fund faster.
female-family-future-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by strong evidence that mentioning children decelerates funding for women.

concrete-business-details-faster.title: Pitches that provide concrete financial figures or specific inventory lists fund faster regardless of gender.
concrete-business-details-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by evidence in both female and male pairs showing specificity predicts slower funding.

female-family-details-slower.title: Pitches from women that include references to their children or specific family obligations are associated with slower funding speeds.
female-family-details-slower.retrospective: Retired to maintain claim cap of 8.

female-boilerplate-slower.title: Pitches from women that utilize generic template language, such as standard greetings or boilerplate phrasing about inspiring others, are associated with slower funding speeds.
female-boilerplate-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by evidence that specific boilerplate phrasing ('hardworking entrepreneur') accelerates funding for women.

financial-specificity-slower-general.title: Providing specific financial figures or detailed inventory lists predicts slower funding regardless of gender.
financial-specificity-slower-general.retrospective: Contradicted by evidence that precise quantities accelerate funding for male borrowers.

loan-history-interaction.title: Referencing previous loan cycles or history with lenders accelerates funding for female borrowers but decelerates it for male borrowers.
loan-history-interaction.retrospective: Retired to make room for high-signal monthly income claim.

female-entrepreneur-phrasing-faster.title: Pitches from women that include the specific descriptor 'hardworking entrepreneur' are associated with increased funding speed.
female-entrepreneur-phrasing-faster.retrospective: Retired to make room for higher-confidence general claim regarding housing status.

housing-status-faster.title: Pitches that explicitly state the borrower owns their own home or provide positive housing status information accelerate funding for both men and women.
housing-status-faster.retrospective: Retired to maintain claim cap of 8 for promotion of female-business-success-faster.
